releasenotes: Safer cache for Pages blocks placed in templates: logged-in members always see blocks built live, and guests get the cached copy only of blocks whose content cannot depend on the viewer or the request (no member data, request, session, cookies, forms, CSRF keys, IP address, randomness, nested blocks or database, widget, template, insert and advertisement tags). The plugin decides per block on its own; the settings page lists which blocks are kept for guests and which are built every time, and why.
